title: Alerts
description: Problems we've spotted with your routers, internet lines and WiFi login page, as they happen.

empty.title: All clear
empty.body: Nothing needs you right now. If a router, internet line or the WiFi login page has a problem, it shows up here straight away.
empty.bodyAruba: Nothing needs you right now. If the WiFi login page has a problem, or you turn on the access point alert above and one goes quiet, it shows up here.

silence.switch: Alert me when access points stop reporting
silence.body: An alert appears on this page if your Aruba Instant On access points go quiet for 30 minutes while guests were still connected, or if one goes quiet for 2 hours while another at the venue is serving guests. Applies to all your Aruba venues.
silence.limits: No guests means no traffic, so a quiet venue does not raise an alert, and an outage with no guests connected will not either. Wyfy can't tell a power cut from a lost internet line; check the Instant On app.
silence.saveFailed: Could not change this alert. Nothing has changed. Try again.
silence.loadFailed: Could not check whether this alert is on. Reload the page to try again.
